section.heading: Access
section.description: See who may work with the whole customer or only with individual projects.
section.inheritedHint: Everything from “Whole customer” also applies here.
section.removeConflict: Someone just changed this member's access. The current state was loaded; try removing it again.

dialog.title: Give access
dialog.description: Choose a member and assign roles for this customer or one of its projects.
dialog.immediateNote: Every change is saved immediately. There is no additional save step.

errors.ACCESS_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: This assignment no longer exists. Reload the customer overview.

tree.globalRolesHint: Global roles also apply here and are granted in the Global roles tab. Project permissions only take effect for the member if they can also see the customer they belong to.

tree.directAndInherited: Assigned directly and also inherited from the customer.
tree.emptyDescription: Assign a role to the whole customer or to an individual project.
